verdicts.reason: Both candidates are basically the same broken skyscraper resize. Each one drops the woman-with-resume photo, which is the key image, along with the divider rules. The text is scattered down a plain grey column: 'HIRING BEST' is tiny, the tilde floats on its own, there is a big gap before 'CANDIDATES', and 'since 1980' is jammed against the bottom edge with stray dots. The only difference is where the dots sit (in A the right dot is near x≈90, in B near x≈63). Neither keeps the hierarchy, grouping or imagery of the original.
